text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُءْيَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا۟ لَكَ كَيْدًا ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

words.gloss_range: completed speech act opening a direct quoted warning by the father
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speaking, and voiced report; here the local perfect verb introduces direct counsel
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) opens the ayah by shifting from Joseph's disclosure to the father's direct answer. The hidden speaker is carried from the prior father reference, so the reply begins without renaming him. The perfect speech verb makes the warning a completed narrative utterance, while the quotation that follows remains live as counsel. The same saying-root also frames a larger danger: vision becomes speech, and speech must be regulated before it reaches the brothers. Later fatherly and brotherly speeches in the surah turn this opening voice into one side of a contested family discourse (12:8; 12:11; 12:17; 12:67; 12:87), and the warning is later confirmed when Satan is named in the fraternal breach (12:100).

topics.headline: direct speech opens fatherly counsel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the father answer as a direct speaker, not as a narrator summary.
topics.reason: The local perfect speech verb introduces words 2-18 as quoted content, and the prior ayah supplies the unspoken father as subject.

topics.headline: vision enters a regulated speech network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is about controlling how seen material becomes spoken material.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect saying, seeing, and narrating roots; locally the father reverses Joseph's disclosure into a command not to disclose further.

topics.headline: fatherly voice stands among rival voices
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this opening speech as the first fatherly advisory voice before later competing voices and later confirmation of the warning.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah references for later brotherly speech, fatherly counsel, and the later Satan explanation (12:8; 12:67; 12:87; 12:100).

words.gloss_range: vocative call establishing the addressed son before the prohibition
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) creates the address frame before any command appears. The particle calls Joseph into direct second-person counsel, so the prohibition is heard as a father's addressed warning rather than a general maxim. Its open sound also gives the vocative a separate beat before the tighter affectionate son-form.

topics.headline: call fixes the addressee before the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears relationship and addressee established before restraint is imposed.
topics.reason: The vocative particle governs the following son-address and precedes the prohibitive clause.

words.gloss_range: affectionate diminutive son-address with first-person possessive force
words.root_gloss_range: building, constructing, and sonship or lineage; here the sonship form carries protective family continuity pressure
words.prose: {{ar:بُنَيَّ}} ({{tr:bunayya}}) is not a bare kinship label. The vocative frame, diminutive pattern, and first-person suffix make the addressee tenderly possessed as the speaker's son before the warning begins. The building-root pressure is narrowed to lineage and family continuity: Joseph is the vulnerable bearer of a family future, not a literal builder in this clause. The case and sound variants orbit the same compressed doubled-y address, so the tender addressee remains stable while the final vowel pressure varies. The same address pattern links this warning with broader parental counsel, including Luqman's prohibition (31:13), while later father-to-sons addresses in this surah widen the concern from one son to the family group (12:67; 12:87).

topics.headline: diminutive possessive makes the warning protective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the prohibition as protective counsel to a beloved son, not as a detached order.
topics.reason: The word is directly governed by the vocative particle and combines diminutive sonship with a first-person possessive suffix.

topics.headline: building-root pressure narrows to family continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that the son is bound to family continuity, while local grammar keeps the word in the sonship address rather than a literal building action.
topics.reason: The root-family evidence supports building and lineage pressure, but the local noun is a son-address, so the pressure is semantic coloring rather than a new local action.

topics.headline: case and sound variants preserve the same tender address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitational and case variation turns around the same compressed affectionate address.
topics.reason: The variant rows concern the vocative form and final sound without changing the addressee or kinship meaning.

topics.headline: singular counsel opens a larger family-address thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this intimate singular address as the start of a wider parental-counsel pattern across the surah and beyond (31:13; 12:67; 12:87).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete parallels for fatherly prohibition and later plural son-addresses, with no local evidence blocking the comparison.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive particle governing the following jussive verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the jussive recounting verb governed by the prohibition

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is a prohibitive particle, not mere descriptive negation. It stands visibly before {{ar:تَقْصُصْ}} ({{tr:taqṣuṣ}}) and governs the command not to narrate. After the affectionate address, this short particle starts the operational restraint and scopes over the whole disclosure phrase through the brothers.

topics.headline: standalone prohibition controls the recounting clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the father is actively stopping a future act, not just predicting danger.
topics.reason: The particle is analyzed as prohibitive and governs the jussive recounting verb inside the quoted command.

words.gloss_range: forbidden recounting or sequence-tracing of the dream to a dangerous audience
words.root_gloss_range: tracking, recounting, following a trace, and related retributive fields; here narration-as-tracing is selected, with other branches kept as pressure only

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the prohibitive particle governing the jussive verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَقْصُصْ}} ({{tr:taqṣuṣ}}) is the act the father blocks. Its jussive form under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) makes the restraint grammatical, and the selected sense is not generic informing but recounting by tracing a sequence. That matters because the dream has ordered symbolic content: telling it would lay a track the brothers could follow. The wider root field of tracking and cutting is narrowed here to narration-as-tracing; it sharpens the danger without making every root branch independently active. The same root also contrasts divine narration to the reader with Joseph's forbidden narration to the brothers (12:3; 18:64; 28:25).

topics.headline: jussive verb is controlled by the prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the disclosure blocked before it happens, with the consequence clause only arriving after the prohibited act is complete.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect second-person masculine singular in jussive mood under the prohibitive particle and governs the dream object plus audience complement.

topics.headline: recounting carries trace-following pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that forbidden telling would trace the dream in a usable sequence for hostile listeners.
topics.reason: The local construction selects recounting the dream; tracking and cutting fields survive as image-pressure, while the retribution branch is not independently selected as the local sense.

topics.headline: suppressed human narration contrasts with authorized narration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the same root can mark divinely authorized narration and physical retracing, while here Joseph is told not to produce such a trace (12:3; 18:64; 28:25).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references where the same root marks narrating or tracing, and local grammar uses that specificity for a forbidden disclosure.

topics.headline: dense sound and boundary handoff mark the forbidden act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the vision move from private self-report into managed speech.
topics.reason: The sound row coheres with the dense recounting verb, and the boundary rows connect Joseph's earlier seeing to the father's restriction and the next verse's interpretation theme.

words.gloss_range: Joseph’s possessed dream-vision as the object whose disclosure is blocked
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, recognizing, and dream-vision; here the marked dream noun turns seeing into a possessed concealable object
words.prose: {{ar:رُءْيَاكَ}} ({{tr:ruʾyāka}}) names the vision as Joseph's own possessed object. The grammar makes what he saw in 12:4 transferable enough to be narrated, then the prohibition stops that transfer. Its form is a marked dream-register noun rather than ordinary seeing, and the internal hamza gives the dream-word a glottal catch; variants around hamza and vowel quality can smooth or assimilate that pressure while leaving the same dream referent in place. Across the surah, this word belongs to the dream spine: concealment here, other dream scenes later, and fulfillment at 12:100.

topics.headline: possessed dream becomes the blocked object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph's seeing has become a possessed object that can be withheld from an audience.
topics.reason: The noun carries a second-person suffix and functions as the direct object of the prohibited recounting verb.

topics.headline: marked dream noun differs from ordinary sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the object as a rare dream-vision form, not routine visual perception.
topics.reason: The supplied occurrence and form evidence mark the noun as a rare abstract dream form; local grammar uses it as the concealed object.

topics.headline: hamza variants mark the word as a recitational pressure point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dream word is acoustically marked even where variants smooth its internal catch.
topics.reason: The variants alter hamza and vowel realization while preserving the dream referent and the command to conceal it.

topics.headline: vision returns from concealment to fulfillment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the concealed dream as the first guarded point in a longer dream arc that reaches interpretation and fulfillment (12:36; 12:43; 12:100).
topics.reason: The rows give repeated same-surah dream references and boundary links, and none contradict the local object relation.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the brothers as the direction and audience of disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) links the forbidden recounting to the brothers as its audience. Its local value is directional, but the underlying upon-pressure makes the disclosure feel like placing the dream onto them. The prepositional phrase completes the prohibited act before the result particle introduces plotting, so the syntax first defines where the dream must not go.

topics.headline: preposition makes the brothers the narration target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that danger begins when the dream is directed onto a specific audience.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches to the recounting verb and governs the brothers as the audience complement; spatial pressure survives as local image without overriding the direction value.

words.gloss_range: Joseph’s blood brothers as the possessed audience who could become agents of harm
words.root_gloss_range: brotherhood, kinship, and close sibling relation; here narrowed to blood brothers tied to Joseph by suffix

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preposition governing the brothers as disclosure target

words.prose: {{ar:إِخْوَتِكَ}} ({{tr:ikhwatika}}) is the intimate danger point. The brothers are governed by {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) as the audience of forbidden disclosure, and the suffix makes them Joseph's own brothers. The plural is narrowed to blood siblings rather than generic companions, so the threat is inside kinship. Structurally they close the prohibited phrase and then become the hidden plural subject of the plotting verb, turning potential hearers into potential agents. Later the same brother-root moves through signs, recognition, and reconciliation (12:7; 12:69; 12:90; 12:100).

topics.headline: possessed brothers are the disclosure audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dream is not being withheld from strangers but from intimate kin who could become actors of harm.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the preposition, bears Joseph's suffix, and supplies the understood subject of the following plural plotting verb.

topics.headline: plural form narrows the relation to blood kin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the danger as a risk within blood brotherhood, not ordinary social fellowship.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows distinguish the blood-brother plural from broader companion language; the weak-radical dispute remains morphological rather than a competing local sense.

topics.headline: threatening brothers become a recognition thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same kinship word starts as a danger marker and later becomes a recognition and reconciliation marker (12:69; 12:90; 12:100).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete same-surah brotherhood references and speech-vision cooccurrence evidence that fit the local warning.

words.gloss_range: causative connector introducing the feared consequence of disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the prohibition into preventive logic. After the completed phrase about not recounting the dream to the brothers, the particle attaches to the plotting verb and makes the next clause a feared consequence rather than a separate prediction. Its force depends on the prior dream content: if that vision reaches the brothers, scheming becomes the anticipated result.

topics.headline: connector turns warning into feared consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the father is preventing a causal chain: disclosure would open the way to plotting.
topics.reason: The particle follows the prohibition, attaches to the subjunctive plotting verb, and introduces the result clause licensed as consequence.

words.gloss_range: prospective covert scheming by the brothers against Joseph
words.root_gloss_range: plotting, strategizing, covert effort, and counter-stratagem; here selected as prospective hostile scheming
words.prose: {{ar:يَكِيدُوا}} ({{tr:yakīdū}}) is prospective, not a report that the brothers have already acted. The result particle controls its mood, and the hidden plural subject carries the brothers forward from the previous word. The verb's root selects covert stratagem rather than open harm, so the dream would become material for calculated response. Its target and cognate noun make the construction heavy: they would scheme against Joseph with an actual scheme. Across the surah, this root opens a scheming thread that later moves through other agents and finally contrasts human plots with divine counter-action (12:28; 12:33; 12:50; 12:76).

topics.headline: subjunctive verb carries brothers into feared result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that plotting is grammatically potential and dependent on disclosure, while the brothers remain the understood agents.
topics.reason: The verb follows the causative particle, has a plural subject resolved to the brothers, takes a target phrase, and is intensified by a cognate accusative.

topics.headline: root selects calculated scheming over open harm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses why dream disclosure is dangerous: it could feed covert, information-sensitive strategy.
topics.reason: The lexical rows consistently identify covert planning and effort, and the local dream context supplies the information that could motivate it.

topics.headline: first scheme root anticipates later exposed schemes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the feared brotherly scheme as the first point in a larger surah pattern of hidden designs and actor reversal (12:28; 12:33; 12:50; 12:76).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete later occurrences where the same root moves from brothers to other social pressure and to divine action.

topics.headline: verb and noun double the scheme-root locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the threat intensified by the local verb-noun echo rather than by the verb alone.
topics.reason: The same root appears in the verb and following cognate noun, and the sound row coheres with the clipped scheme phrase.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus suffix marking Joseph as the adversarial target of the scheme
words.prose: {{ar:لَكَ}} ({{tr:laka}}) keeps Joseph in view after the dream noun. The same second-person addressee becomes the target of the brothers' prospective scheme. Although the compact preposition often has a relation or benefit shape, the plotting verb forces an adversarial value here: the movement is toward Joseph as target, not for his benefit.

topics.headline: compact relation phrase marks Joseph as target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Joseph shift from possessor of the dream to target of the response.
topics.reason: The preposition plus second-person suffix is governed by the plotting verb, which selects adversarial targeting rather than benefit.

words.gloss_range: indefinite cognate scheme noun intensifying the prospective plotting
words.root_gloss_range: plot, stratagem, calculated effort, and counter-action; here a concrete but unspecified plotted scheme
words.prose: {{ar:كَيْدًا}} ({{tr:kaydan}}) does not add a separate object; it repeats the scheme-root as a cognate accusative. That repetition makes the feared result deliberate and concrete, while the indefinite ending leaves the exact plot unnamed. The word also begins an audible indefinite thread that later meets the enemy predicate and its final adjective. Within the surah, the root will return as hidden designs become exposed and reinterpreted (12:28; 12:33; 12:50; 12:52).

topics.headline: cognate noun intensifies the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the threat as an intensified scheming act, not a light or incidental hostility.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the noun as cognate accusative from the same root as the verb, so it emphasizes and specifies the action.

topics.headline: indefinite noun leaves the plot concrete but unnamed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the father warns of real deliberate strategy without naming a fixed future plan.
topics.reason: The lexical rows identify an organized plot, while the indefinite form keeps its specific shape open.

topics.headline: scheme noun links local threat to later plot scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the concrete social-threat word carry the dream outward into the surah's later scheming scenes.
topics.reason: The rows connect the noun to later same-root scenes and to the boundary from dream content into social threat.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the nominal rationale clause
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) pivots from the family warning into its asserted ground. It governs the following Satan noun and opens the nominal clause that explains why disclosure is dangerous. The final sentence does not merely add a comment; it universalizes the specific counsel by stating a confirmed enemy relation between Satan and the human being.

topics.headline: particle asserts and governs the following noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing rationale formally asserted, with emphasis visible in the governed noun.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following noun as its subject complement and opens the emphasized nominal sentence.

topics.headline: specific counsel resolves into universal explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah move from one family risk to a general principle that explains it.
topics.reason: The final clause is linked as explanation inside the quotation and structurally resolves the earlier command and feared consequence.

words.gloss_range: the definite recognized Satan figure as subject of the enemy rationale
words.root_gloss_range: distance, rebellion, and disputed burning pressure; here the named adversary who explains human scheming
words.prose: {{ar:الشَّيْطَانَ}} ({{tr:al-shayṭāna}}) is introduced as a known adversary, not as an abstract evil quality. The emphatic particle governs it as the subject of the final enemy statement. Its singular definite form makes the explanation stable: the brothers' possible scheme is relocated under a wider adversarial relation without erasing their agency. The disputed root pressures of distance and burning are narrowed to coloring the adversary title: the name can suggest distancing humans from safety and consuming trust within kinship, while the local clause still selects the recognized adversary. The same figure later appears in the surah as a concrete agent of forgetting and separation (12:42; 12:100), while the enemy formula also echoes public warning passages (2:168; 2:208; 6:142; 17:53; 36:60; 43:62).

topics.headline: definite noun is the asserted subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes Satan as a known singular adversary invoked as the ground of the warning.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, concrete, singular in local form, and accusative as the governed subject of the emphatic clause.

topics.headline: distance and burning pressures color the adversary title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses distancing and consuming pressure behind the name, while the local clause still uses it as the recognized adversary title.
topics.reason: The rows preserve a derivational dispute; local grammar selects the named adversary, so etymological pressures remain coloring rather than competing referents.

topics.headline: Satanic enmity reframes possible brotherly plotting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the warning name intimate family risk while refusing to make sibling psychology the final explanation.
topics.reason: The final clause moves from the brothers' potential plotting to Satan as the broader explanatory subject in a fixed enemy statement.

topics.headline: enemy formula returns as narrative agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader links the private warning to public enemy formulas and to later same-surah enactment when Satan is named again (12:42; 12:100; 17:53).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete cross-surah formula references and same-surah returns, with the sound row adding local acoustic marking.

words.gloss_range: relational preposition directing the enemy predicate toward the human category
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes the human category the target relation inside the final clause. It is not benefactive here; the enemy predicate selects an adversarial direction. Because the prepositional phrase is heard before the enemy noun, the affected human being is foregrounded before the declaration names the enemy role.

topics.headline: preposition directs enmity toward the human
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that humanity is placed as the directed target of enmity before the enemy noun arrives.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the human noun in the predicate phrase; the enemy predicate makes the relation adversarial rather than beneficial.

words.gloss_range: the definite singular human category as target of Satanic enmity
words.root_gloss_range: sociability, human familiarity, disputed forgetfulness, and movement pressure; here the human being as a universal moral type
words.prose: {{ar:الْإِنْسَانَ}} ({{tr:al-insāna}}) expands the warning beyond Joseph without leaving the wording. The definite singular presents the human being as a category, not merely one person or a plural public. Governed by the preceding relation particle, the human is the target of the enemy predicate. The derivational debate around sociability, forgetfulness, and restless movement remains interpretively useful: the same family setting exposes social bonds, and later Satan-related forgetting appears in the surah (12:42). But the local function is still the universal human type in a Satan-enemy formula, with contrasts to wider public language elsewhere in the surah (12:21; 12:46; 12:49; 12:103) and to broader enemy-formula or class language (6:112; 17:53).

topics.headline: definite singular universalizes the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Jacob's warning move from Joseph's family situation to the human being as a moral type.
topics.reason: The definite singular noun in the final rationale presents humanity categorically rather than naming Joseph or using a plural public term.

topics.headline: humanity is governed as enemy target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that humanity is not a loose topic but the directed target in the Satan-enemy relation.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the relation particle and appears in a cooccurrence field with Satan and enmity.

topics.headline: human root debate remains locally suggestive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses social vulnerability, forgetfulness, and instability as pressures around the human category, while the local noun remains the generic human being.
topics.reason: The derivational rows are meaningful because the scene involves social bonds and later forgetting (12:42), but they do not replace the local categorical noun sense.

topics.headline: human type contrasts with public audiences
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the human moral type in this formula from later public or collective audience language (12:21; 12:46; 6:112; 17:53).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete contrasts with public terms and cross-surah enemy formulas, and the local singular category supports the distinction.

words.gloss_range: indefinite intensive enemy predicate classifying Satan as a manifest adversary
words.root_gloss_range: enmity, transgression, crossing bounds, and hostile opposition; here habitual adversary as nominal predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the final adjective agreeing with the enemy predicate

words.prose: {{ar:عَدُوٌّ}} ({{tr:ʿaduwwun}}) supplies the predicate of the emphatic clause. Because the sentence is nominal, enmity is presented as an identity relation rather than a single event. The indefinite form classifies Satan as an enemy, and the intensive pattern gives the hostility durable force. Root pressure from crossing and transgression fits the scene: protected dream knowledge could cross into hostile hands. The shared indefinite ending with {{ar:مُبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) binds noun and adjective into one compact predicate pair. The word also joins the familiar enemy formula with the final adjective, a formula that appears in wider warning contexts and is narratively embodied when Satan is later named as causing separation between Joseph and his brothers (12:100; also 2:168; 2:208; 6:142; 36:60; 43:62).

topics.headline: nominal predicate classifies Satan as enemy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that enmity is stated as a durable classification, not a one-time hostile act.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the noun as the predicate of the emphatic clause, and its indefiniteness supports classifying predication.

topics.headline: intensive form carries habitual transgression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels Satanic hostility as habitual boundary-crossing pressure suited to a scene about guarded disclosure.
topics.reason: The rows tie the form to habitual intensity and the root to transgression or crossing; local context supplies the boundary of protected dream knowledge.

topics.headline: formulaic enemy noun is later embodied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a public warning formula inside private counsel and then sees that enemy claim embodied in the later separation scene (12:100).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete formula parallels and same-surah fulfillment references; the local noun is part of the recognized enemy-adjective pair.

topics.headline: shared indefinite ending binds noun and adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the enemy noun and final adjective bound as one compact predicate pair.
topics.reason: The sound row coheres with agreement between the predicate noun and following adjective.

words.gloss_range: final active-participle adjective marking the enemy as manifest and clarifying
words.root_gloss_range: separation, distinction, clarity, and making clear; here a manifest or manifesting quality attached to the enemy predicate
words.prose: {{ar:مُبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) seals the ayah as the adjective of the enemy noun. Agreement keeps it attached to the predicate rather than floating as a second claim. As a Form IV active participle, it can carry both manifest and making-clear force: the enemy is evident, and the formula openly declares that enmity. The root's separation pressure is narrowed to clarity here, but it quietly prepares the later language of Satan stirring between Joseph and his brothers (12:100). The final position leaves the warning on declared clarity, and its tanwīn cadence ties the possible plot, the enemy noun, and the manifest adjective into an audible indefinite chain. The same adjective recurs in contested human judgments within the surah (12:8; 12:30) and in wider enemy formulas (2:168; 2:208; 6:142; 36:60; 43:62).

topics.headline: final adjective locks to enemy predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word complete one compact enemy predicate rather than starting a separate claim.
topics.reason: The word agrees with the enemy noun in case and indefiniteness and occupies the ayah-final adjective position.

topics.headline: active participle keeps manifest and clarifying senses live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the enemy as both plainly evident and openly disclosed by the formula.
topics.reason: The Form IV participle evidence supports both stative and agentive clarity, while local agreement attaches that quality to the enemy.

topics.headline: separation pressure prepares later between-ness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses a clarity word that also belongs to the surah's later judgments and separation language, while the local sense remains the manifest enemy adjective (12:8; 12:30; 12:100).
topics.reason: The root includes separation and between-ness, but local form and syntax select an adjective of clarity; same-surah references preserve the thread without replacing the local sense.

topics.headline: final word seals a recognized enemy formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the private warning close inside a known enemy formula with an audible final seal (2:168; 2:208; 6:142; 36:60; 43:62).
topics.reason: The rows connect the final adjective to recurring enemy formulas and to the local ending cadence, making the closure more than a generic adjective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition on recounting the vision is joined directly to the doubled warning that the brothers may scheme a scheme.
baseline_models.mechanism: Voicing converts a sleeper's inward perception into an ordered report. The q-s-s branches make that report both sequential news and a trail that can be followed, while the split r-w-y target makes the vision portable as narrated material; k-y-d then names its forceful strategic processing.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance supplies the act that moves private content into another person's hearing.
Sequential reporting turns dream details into an ordered narrative that can be retained and used.
Following an effect step by step makes the told vision a traceable path rather than inert information.
The dream branch locates the content first in the sleeper's private field of seeing.
The split-root narration branch makes the seen content portable as report, sharpening the disclosure mechanism.
Forceful handling supplies the sustained processing by which disclosed material can be turned against its teller.

changed_reading.before: A father simply forbids sharing a dream because jealous brothers may plot.
changed_reading.after: The warning treats narration as a conversion event: an inward vision becomes an ordered, followable script that close recipients can process into a sustained scheme.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The address to a son, the naming of brothers, and the sequence from Satan to enemy to manifest all sit inside one kinship warning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sonship and brotherhood establish a constructed bond, with brotherhood also carrying the image of a tether. The adversarial sequence crosses the bond's limit and converts connection into distance and separation; its being manifest can name the legible shape of that conversion rather than merely an obvious external actor.

activation_trace.role: Sonship supplies the genealogical relation within which the warning is meant to preserve a place.
The tether image makes brotherhood a binding relation whose very closeness can be strained or redirected.
Distance and severance supply the adversarial operation performed upon the family bond.
Crossing a rightful limit supplies the directional breach by which kinship becomes injury.
A connection standing between parties supplies the relation that the warning seeks to keep intact.
Separation after connection supplies the visible end-state of the adversarial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Satan is an obvious external enemy who may prompt hostile brothers.
changed_reading.after: The enemy's manifest signature is relational: it crosses kinship limits and turns a binding tie into distance and separation from within.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dangerous recipients are familiar brothers, while the concluding generalization names the enemy in relation to the human being.
baseline_models.mechanism: The human root activates sensing and familiarity that remove estrangement. Those ordinarily protective capacities become the channel through which disclosed inner material is noticed and exploited, so manifest enmity can operate through recognizable human intimacy rather than only from outside it.

activation_trace.role: Seeing, hearing, and sensing supply the human receptivity through which the disclosed vision becomes available.
Familiarity that removes estrangement supplies the trusted social channel that can be inverted.
Close kinship identifies the intimate recipients in whom the human vulnerability is concentrated.
Enmity opposed to alliance supplies the inversion of a channel expected to be friendly.
Appearance and disclosure make the recurrent hostile pattern detectable even when it moves through familiar people.

changed_reading.before: A manifest enemy is simply an identifiable supernatural antagonist.
changed_reading.after: Enmity becomes manifest in a repeatable human vulnerability: familiar sensing and companionship can become the access path for weaponizing disclosed inner content.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same q-s-s field forbidden in the focus is used immediately beforehand for the best narration, and that narration arrives through hidden imparting. The contrast revises silence from rejection of narrative into control of channel, audience, and time.

activation_trace.role: Sequential reporting supplies the act locally withheld from the brothers.
Ordered narration supplies a positively authorized use of the same reporting field.
Knowledge imparted in concealment supplies a protected channel from which public narration can later emerge.

structural_cues: 12:3 uses the repeated q-s-s root for valued narration immediately before 12:5 restricts its use.
The context pairs narration with hidden delivery, whereas the focus specifies a dangerous audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one authorized narration, one hidden channel, and one local prohibition; I infer that timing and recipient, not truth or narratability, control disclosure. A live alternative is that 12:3 and 12:5 use the same root without prescribing a general disclosure sequence.

changed_reading.before: The dream should remain unspoken because narration itself is dangerous.
changed_reading.after: The dream is not anti-narrative material; it is a true story under embargo until it can move through an authorized channel and fitting time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs and a clear book establish public intelligibility, while reason carries the image of restraint. Against that frame, the focus does not oppose clarity; it distinguishes a sign's truth from the prudence of exposing it to every audience.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure by speech or sign supplies the focus's problem of when meaning should be made available.
An outward sign supplies a context in which genuine meaning can be publicly legible.
Open manifestation supplies the public clarity that coexists with the focus's selective concealment.
Reason as restraint supplies the governing brake on indiscriminate disclosure.

structural_cues: 12:1-2 foreground signs, clarity, and understanding before the private dream scene.
12:5 itself joins non-disclosure to a causal risk rather than to doubt about the vision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public signs, manifest meaning, rational restraint, and a private disclosure ban; I infer different disclosure regimes for different truths. The alternative is that the opening clarity language only describes the scripture and does not qualify the father's advice.

changed_reading.before: Keeping the dream secret is the opposite of making truth clear.
changed_reading.after: Disciplined concealment can serve clarity: a true sign may need audience restraint so that disclosure does not corrupt its course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dream depicts a many-to-one lowering, and the next ayah names selection and completion. These cues specify what the brothers could infer from the report: not merely a strange image, but a future asymmetry of rank and favor.

activation_trace.role: The sleeper's vision supplies the symbolic content whose social implication is at issue.
Brotherly kinship supplies the comparison set within which unequal rank can become threatening.
Lowering and submission supply the dream's visible relation of many figures beneath one recipient.
Selection and drawing near supply the prospective elevation encoded by the dream.
Arrival at completion supplies a future trajectory rather than a momentary spectacle.

structural_cues: 12:4 gives the dream a many-to-one posture before the warning in 12:5.
12:6 follows the warning with selection, teaching, and completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies submission imagery followed by selection and completion; I infer that hearers could decode these as status displacement and act preemptively. A live alternative is that the brothers would react affectively without grasping any precise future hierarchy.

changed_reading.before: The brothers may resent an impressive dream.
changed_reading.after: The dream functions as a rank signal: disclosure lets the brothers read a coming asymmetry of selection, submission, and completed favor as a threat to their place.

context_deltas.mechanism: Love lodged in the heart is framed as unequally allocated, while the brothers name themselves through a branch of collective encirclement and mutual support. The plot therefore emerges as coalition mechanics around perceived scarcity, not as parallel private jealousies.

activation_trace.role: The kinship tether supplies the bond from which a tighter faction can be formed.
Strategic contrivance supplies the coordinated action produced by the faction.
Heart-attached love supplies the resource the brothers perceive as distributed against them.
A mutually supporting encircling group supplies the social body able to convert grievance into a plan.

structural_cues: 12:8 moves from comparative love to the brothers' self-description as one group.
The plural plot anticipated in 12:5 is followed by collective speech and collective proposals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perceived unequal love and a self-conscious supporting group; I infer that scarcity organizes the group into a coalition. The alternative is that the group label only asserts strength and does not itself cause coordination.

changed_reading.before: Each brother is individually jealous and may join a plot.
changed_reading.after: Perceived scarcity of paternal affection binds the brothers into a coalition whose mutual reinforcement is itself the machinery of the plot.

context_deltas.mechanism: The proposals aim to empty the father's face or attention, actively produce distance, and place the son in a hidden depression and cut-off cavity. The context realizes the focus's bond-to-severance topology as a spatial intervention.

activation_trace.role: Sonship supplies the genealogical place from which the target is to be removed.
Distance and severance supply the focus-level operation later made spatial.
Separation after connection supplies the plot's relational result.
Emptiness of a place supplies the brothers' desired clearing of paternal attention.
The face standing for the person supplies the relational field they want exclusively turned toward themselves.
Causing distance supplies the explicit transition from kinship proximity to removal.
A depression in which something disappears supplies the concealed spatial destination.
Cutting from the root supplies the pit's relational function as de-attachment from household and lineage.

structural_cues: 12:9 progresses from killing or casting away to an explicitly empty paternal field.
12:10 replaces immediate killing with concealment in the pit, preserving removal while changing its means.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emptying, the father's face, caused distance, concealment, and a cut-off pit; I infer that these spatial actions model engineered absence from a relational field. The live alternative is a simpler plan to monopolize affection without a broader severance topology.

changed_reading.before: The plot is an unspecified attempt to harm Joseph.
changed_reading.after: The plot is engineered absence: remove a son from his genealogical place, clear the father's field of attention, and materialize severance in a hidden cavity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before physical removal, the brothers manufacture a verbal security envelope: they solicit trust, claim freedom from fraud, and promise guarding. The focus's plot therefore begins in speech that counterfeits the conditions under which access is granted.

activation_trace.role: Speech that attributes what is not so supplies the focus-level possibility of language becoming deceptive action.
Counterfactual assertion supplies the verbal surface on which the access request is built.
Settled security and trust supply the state the brothers ask the father to enter.
Purity from fraud supplies the exact quality falsely claimed for their intent.
Guarding and watchfulness supply the protective promise used to secure custody.

structural_cues: 12:11-12 place trust, sincerity, and guarding in a coordinated request for access.
The physical plan in 12:9-10 is therefore preceded in execution by persuasive speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prior plan followed by claims of trustworthiness and protection; I infer that those claims are an operational stage of the scheme. The alternative is that some claims express mixed or self-deceived motives rather than conscious counterfeiting by every speaker.

changed_reading.before: The brothers' plot begins when they physically seize Joseph.
changed_reading.after: The first operation is linguistic: counterfeit trust, sincerity, and guardianship create the access needed for physical removal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The father voices a specific feared predator and a lapse of attention; the brothers later return with that predator as their account and with falsehood exposed. The sequence makes disclosed vulnerability itself reusable narrative material.

activation_trace.role: Sequential reporting supplies the general risk that words can furnish an ordered script.
Anticipatory fear supplies the vulnerable scenario voiced in advance.
The predatory wolf supplies the concrete actor in the father's feared scenario.
Exploiting another's lapse supplies the condition that makes the scenario narratively plausible.
The same predator returns as the asserted cause, showing reuse of the earlier scenario.
Falsehood opposed to truth identifies the returned account as a fabricated cover.

structural_cues: 12:13 voices wolf and heedlessness before the brothers leave.
12:17 repeats the wolf inside their account, and 12:18 marks the attached evidence with falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a feared scenario before departure and the same scenario in the later account; I infer appropriation of exposed fear as a cover script. A live alternative is that the wolf was an obvious shared danger independently available to both father and sons.

changed_reading.before: The command not to tell the dream protects only the dream's symbolic content.
changed_reading.after: The warning exposes a broader information hazard: once a vulnerability is spoken, hostile hearers can return it as the ready-made plot of their alibi.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers gather their intent and hide Joseph, but hidden imparting installs a future report that will reach them while their fine awareness fails. Concealment is therefore not the last word: the focus's withheld story persists as a deferred counter-disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The locally withheld report supplies the narrative whose future delivery remains open.
Eventual manifestation supplies the horizon against which temporary concealment is read.
Collusive gathering around one affair supplies the brothers' coordinated concealment channel.
Knowledge implanted in concealment supplies a protected counterchannel inside the pit episode.
A report that arrives and is delivered supplies the promised later reversal of who tells whom.
Fine-grained awareness supplies the faculty the plotters lack while the counter-report is seeded.

structural_cues: 12:15 juxtaposes the brothers' completed concealment with a hidden message to Joseph.
The promised future report reverses the focus scene: the one warned not to tell will later tell the plotters their own affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collusive concealment, hidden knowledge, promised report, and failed awareness; I infer a protected narrative counterchannel that preserves disclosure for later. The alternative is that the hidden message only consoles Joseph and does not revise the disclosure logic of 12:5.

changed_reading.before: Silence is merely a defensive absence of speech.
changed_reading.after: Silence preserves a deferred report: hostile concealment is answered by hidden knowledge that will later reverse teller and audience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus names Satan as enemy to the human; the later diagnosis names selves that beautify an affair to their bearers. The context relocates the adversarial route inside human valuation, where a harmful plan is made attractive enough to enact.

activation_trace.role: Rebellious satanic agency supplies the focus's transgressive adversary.
The human being supplies the host domain in which the adversarial process takes effect.
The self or Satan beautifying an affair supplies the internal valuation step that makes wrongdoing actionable.
Inner thought and apprehension supply the human interior in which the affair is reframed.

structural_cues: 12:5 places Satan in a general enemy relation to the human.
12:18 diagnoses the completed affair through the brothers' own selves rather than naming an external compulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies satanic enmity and later self-adornment; I infer that beautified self-appraisal is one human execution channel of that enmity. A materially live alternative keeps satanic prompting and autonomous self-deception as parallel, not causally nested, agencies.

changed_reading.before: Satan acts as an external instigator who inserts a hostile plan.
changed_reading.after: The adversary can become internalized as valuation: the human self beautifies the harmful affair until kinship violation feels enactable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers arrive under low visibility, perform grief, and present a blood-marked garment with a false account. The focus's manifest enemy is thus not opposed to appearances; hostile action can manufacture an apparently self-evident surface and demand that it be read as truth.

activation_trace.role: A true inward vision supplies one mode of seeing against which staged outward evidence will compete.
Manifest appearance supplies the epistemic surface that hostile staging can imitate.
Night darkness and reduced clarity supply the controlled conditions of the presentation.

strongest_changes: The shared q-s-s root in 12:3 and 12:5 changes the prohibition from anti-narration into audience- and time-governed disclosure.
The dream becomes a future rank signal, while unequal love and group solidarity explain how brothers become a coordinated coalition.
The plot is concretized as engineered absence and begins operationally with counterfeit trust before physical removal.
The father's spoken wolf fear returns as the brothers' cover story, making exposed vulnerability itself reusable narrative material.
Manifest enmity includes contested visibility: hidden counter-knowledge survives while staged tears, blood, and cloth manufacture a false surface.
The Satan-human relation remains compatible with internal human agency through the later image of selves beautifying the affair.
summary.what_was_special: The packet activated several coexisting conversions rather than one moral gloss: private vision into actionable trace, kinship tether into severance, affection scarcity into coalition, son into found object, hidden knowledge into deferred report, and visible evidence into counterfeit manifestation. The non-dominant r-w-y narration target and the exact garment-that-lies branch were especially productive without displacing the ordinary readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The trace-following sense of q-s-s may be an illuminating mechanism without being active in the immediate syntax.
The rank-threat reading depends on the brothers decoding the dream's posture and later selection language more specifically than the packet states.
The arrow from the father's voiced fear to the brothers' alibi is abductively strong but could reflect an independently obvious danger.
The slow-spark, social-contagion, and de-kinning models are deliberately branch-distant analogies and need explicit qualification.
Self-adornment may instantiate satanic enmity, or the packet may preserve satanic prompting and autonomous human self-deception as parallel agencies.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Recounting can expose a trace to hostile handling.** ق ص ص B002 (sequential recounting), ك ي د B001/B002 (forceful handling; stratagem), and ع د و B001/B003 (overstepping a bound; enmity) form the warning. 2. **Remoteness enters the brotherly bond.** ش ط ن B001/B004 (distance; rebellious devil) is placed against ء خ و B001 (brotherhood). The packet supplies the juxtaposition; I infer that incitement works by producing relational distance inside kinship. The enemy is both an agent and a mechanism of estrangement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:100 named نزع الشيطان بين the brothers, surprisingly confirming that the enemy mechanism in this ayah is produced distance inside kinship.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Disclosure as usable material for a stratagem.** The noun and verb intensify `ك ي د:B002`, “plotting and stratagem”; `ق ص ص:B002` supplies connected recounting. In 12:8-10 the brothers turn their comparative grievance into a sequence of proposed actions. The packet gives the warning followed by the scheme; I infer that telling the dream would furnish the plotters with both motive and a target-state to reverse. The prohibition therefore reads as causal information control, not a vague fear of envy.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:76 attributes a stratagem to divine enabling, so the surah ultimately prevents *kayd* from being treated as intrinsically corrupt; disclosure still furnishes action, but moral evaluation depends on its assigned end.

يدخل فيه القول في الإلهام، حيث يسمى إلقاء المعنى قولا من غير خطاب وارد.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi uzun, sıkı bükülmüş ve su çekmede kullanılan ipi açıkça tanımlar; ayrıca bu iple bağlama eylemini ve iki iple kovayı çeken kişiyi de aynı dalda verir. Geçici çerçeve bu araç, eylem ve görev ayrımını doğru biçimde yakalar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Uzun ipin ad anlamı ile bu ipi gerektiren bağlama ve su çekme kullanımları ayrı tutulur; özel yapılar yalın bir bağlama anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Su çekmede kullanılan, uzun ve sıkı bükülmüş bir iptir; aynı dal, bir şeyi bu iple bağlama eylemini de kapsar. İki iple kovayı kuyudan çeken kişi bu araç ve iş düzeninin özel bir katılımcısıdır.

facets.statement: Temel nesne, özellikle kuyudan su çekmeye yarayan uzun ve sıkı bükülmüş iptir.
İpin adlandırılması, iki ucu arasında büyük bir uzaklık bulunmasıyla açıklanır.
Eylem kullanımı, bir hayvanı ya da başka bir şeyi bu uzun iple sıkıca bağlamaktır.
İki ayrı iple kovayı kuyudan çeken kişi, su çekme düzenine bağlı özel bir adla anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, uzun ve sıkı bükülmüş ipin kuyudan su çekmekte kullanıldığını, adının iki ucu arasındaki uzaklıkla açıklandığını ve aynı kökten gelen eylemin bu iple bağlamak anlamına geldiğini bildirir. İki iple kovayı çeken kişi de bu iş düzeninin özel katılımcısıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanlar, görünmez varlıklar ve hayvanlar arasındaki her azgın başkaldıranı aynı ad altında toplar; kişinin böyle bir varlığa dönüşmesini ve onun gibi davranmasını da açıkça verir. Kötü huyun aynı adla anılması dalın insan davranışına uzanan bağımlı görünümüdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Varlık adı, her azgın başkaldırana yönelik tür adı, kişide ona benzeme eylemi ve kötü huy nitelemesi birbirine karıştırılmadan verilir.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlar, görünmez varlıklar veya hayvanlar arasında azgınca başkaldıran, iyilikten uzaklaşan ve kötülükte ileri giden varlığa verilen addır. Bir kişinin böyle bir varlık gibi davranması ve kötü bir huyun onunla adlandırılması bu çekirdeğe bağlı uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Ad, türü ne olursa olsun azgın, taşkın ve başkaldıran varlığı belirtir.
Adın türeyişi, varlığın iyiden uzaklaşması ve başkaldırması düşüncesiyle açıklanır.
Bir kişinin bu kötücül varlığa benzemesi ve onun yaptıklarını yapması ayrı eylem biçimleriyle anlatılır.
İnsandaki yerilmiş ve kötü bir huy da benzetme yoluyla aynı varlık adıyla anılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, insanlar, görünmez varlıklar ve hayvanlar arasındaki her azgın başkaldıranı kapsayan bir varlık adı verir ve bu adı uzaklaşma düşüncesiyle açıklar. Kişinin böyle bir varlığa dönüşüp onun gibi davranması ile insandaki kötü bir huyun aynı adla anılması da bu çekirdeğin uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan, görünmez varlık ya da hayvan ayrımı yapmadan dalın ortak azgınlık, başkaldırı ve kötülük çekirdeğini karşılar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısındaki insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ve tek bir üyesini birlikte gösterir. Görünür olma açıklaması adlandırma gerekçesidir; insan olmanın kurucu tanımı değildir. Evde kimsenin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıp ise dal çekirdeğine genellenemez ve yalnızca kendi sözcüksel biriminde korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimlerdeki insan ve insan topluluğu anlamı dal çekirdeğidir; evde hiç kimse bulunmadığını anlatan kalıp ayrı tutulur ve çekirdeğe yeni bir genel anlam katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında yer alan insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ya da tek bir üyesini belirtir. İnsanların görünür oluşu, bu adlandırma için aktarılan bir gerekçedir.

Adlandırmanın insanların duyularla görünür oluşuna bağlanması, anlamın özü değil kökene ilişkin bir açıklamadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, dalın insan türünü hem topluluk hem tek kişi olarak gösterebildiğinde ve görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfıyla karşıtlık kurduğunda birleşir. Görünürlük, ortak anlamdan çok adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak sunulur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi görmeyi temel alır, fakat belirli kullanımlarda işitmeyi, bir belirtiyi anlayıp ayırt etmeyi ve çevreye bakarak birini aramayı da aynı dalda aktarır. Bu yüzden dal genel ve sınırsız bir algı yetisi diye tanımlanamaz; her uzantı kendi bağlamına bağlı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Görüp fark etme çekirdeği ile ses işitme, olgunluk belirtisini ayırt etme ve çevreye bakıp araştırma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplardaki kapsam çıplak biçime genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi görüp fark etmeyi anlatır. Belirli kullanımlarda bir sesi işitmeye, bir kimsedeki olgunluk belirtisini ya da kaygı veren bir durumu sezmeye ve çevreye bakarak birinin bulunup bulunmadığını araştırmaya uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi gözle görerek fark etmeyi veya seçmeyi anlatır.
Belirli bir ses nesnesiyle kullanıldığında o sesi işitmeyi anlatır.
Bir kimsedeki olgunluk belirtisini bilip ayırt etmeyi veya kaygı veren bir durumu duyularla sezmeyi anlatabilir.
Çevreye bakıp dikkatle araştırarak birinin bulunup bulunmadığını anlamaya çalışma kullanımını taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarılan anlam alanının merkezi görüp fark etmektir. Aynı ifade ailesi belirli nesne ve yapılarda işitme, bir belirtiyi anlayıp ayırt etme, kaygı veren şeyi sezme ve bakıp araştırma yönlerinde kullanılır; bunlar sınırsız bir genel algı anlamı oluşturmaz.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عاد ورجع، والعودة، والعود بعد البدء، والمعاودة، والإعادة، واستعادة الشيء، وتعاود القوم، وعودة الحمى والمسألة، وصيغة عواد وعد، والعوادة من الطعام المعاد.
يدخل فيه المعاد بمعنى المصير والمرجع، والزمان أو المكان الذي يعود إليه، ومعاد الحاج، ومعاد مكة أو الآخرة والجنة في نقل المصادر.
يدخل فيه قولهم ما يبدئ وما يعيد أو لا يبدي ولا يعيد بمعنى لا يتكلم ببادئة ولا عائدة.
يدخل فيه العادة، والاعتياد، والتعود، والدربة حتى تصير سجية، والمواظبة، ومعاودة الحرب، والفحل المعتاد للضراب، والمطيق للشيء لأنه اعتاده.
يدخل فيه عيادة المريض، وعواد المريض، والمعادة في المصيبة أو المأتم التي يغشاها الناس، وما يرجع فيه الزائر مرة بعد مرة.
يدخل فيه العائدة، والمعروف والصلة والفضل، وما عاد على الإنسان بنفع أو رفق أو عطف، وقولهم هذا أعود عليك.
يدخل فيه العيد، والأعياد، وكل يوم مجمع أو يوم سرور، وما يعاود الإنسان من هم أو حب أو حال، وشهود العيد.
يدخل فيه العود من الإبل، والبعير أو الجمل المسن، والناقة أو الشاة أو الفرس في نقل بعض العرب، وما بلغ وقت السن بعد البزول، والاستعارة في الاستعانة بأهل السن والمعرفة.
يدخل فيه الطريق القديم أو العادي، والسؤدد العود، والرحم العود أو العودة بمعنى القديمة، وكل قدم صرحت به المصادر في هذا اللفظ.
يدخل فيه العود من الخشب، وكل خشبة أو خشبة دقيقة في نقل مقاييس، وعود التبخر، والعود الذي يضرب به أو المزهر المعروف.
يدخل فيه العود في الظهار، سواء فسر بتكرار القول، أو الجماع بعد الظهار، أو إمساك المرأة، أو فعل ما حلف ألا يفعله بحسب الأقوال المنقولة.
يدخل فيه عاد القبيلة، والنسبة عادي بمعنى قديم منسوب إلى عاد، واسم عادياء، والإبل العيدية المنسوبة إلى فحل أو إلى عاد بحسب النقل.

concept_gloss.text: Bir yerden, nesneden ya da işten ayrıldıktan sonra ona geri yönelmek veya başlanmış bir şeyi bir kez daha yapmak; türemiş biçimlerde bir başkasına yeniden yaptırmak ya da tekrar istemektir.
Bir varlığın sonunda döneceği yer veya ulaşacağı son durak; bağlama göre dönüşün gerçekleştiği zaman ya da mekândır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı ayrılma, kopma ve birbirinden uzak düşme çevresinde kurar. Geçici çerçeve bunu sadık biçimde karşılar; sözlü açıklık veya yer aralığı anlamları bu dalın çekirdeğine taşınmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım herhangi bir özel kalıptan alınan boşluk, zaman veya söz açıklığı anlamını ithal etmez.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam ayrılma, kopma ve tarafların birbirinden ayrı hale gelmesidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Birlik, temas veya yakınlık sonrasında gerçekleşen ayrılma çekirdeğini en kısa biçimde verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı açığa çıkarma, sözü açık olma ve anlatım yetkinliği çevresindedir. Geçici çerçeve doğru olmakla birlikte bu dalın genel görünme dalından ayrı tutulması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karma yapıdadır; anlam açıklama çekirdeği ile açık sözlü kişi kalıbı ayrı ama bağlı kullanımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir anlamı söz, yazı, işaret veya düzgün anlatımla açığa çıkarıp anlaşılır kılmadır; kişide açık ve düzgün konuşma yetisi olarak da kullanılır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, kastedilen anlamı açığa çıkarıp anlaşılır kılmadır.
Bu açıklama sadece konuşmayla değil yazı, işaret veya başka gösterme yollarıyla da olabilir.
Kişi için açık, düzgün ve etkili konuşma yetisi anlamı vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı açığa çıkarma ve sözü açık olma alanında birleşir; bazıları düzgün konuşmayı, bazıları ise konuşmadan daha geniş açıklama yollarını vurgular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Söz, yazı veya işaretle anlamı anlaşılır kılma çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Anlamı açığa çıkarma ve anlaşılır kılma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün, yazının veya işaretin anlamı anlaşılır kıldığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Anlatım yoluyla anlamı açık kılmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin konuşmasının açık ve düzgün olduğunu bildiren kullanımlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişideki açık ve düzgün konuşma niteliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da açık ve düzgün anlatım alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal açıklama işlevini daha geniş araçlarla verir; komşu dal konuşma yetkinliği ve maksada erişen söz alanında yoğunlaşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal anlamı açıkça ortaya koyma ve sözü anlaşılır olma durumudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal konuşmada tutulma, yetersizlik ve anlatım güçsüzlüğüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da konuşma ve anlamı aktarabilme eksenindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal açıklığı ve anlaşılır anlatımı verir; komşu dal bunun yokluğu veya aksamasını verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal anlamı bir araçla açıklama etkinliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal şeyin açık hale gelmesi veya belirgin kanıt olmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da açıklık ve anlaşılır hale gelme vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ifade edici eyleme bağlıdır; komşu dal nesnenin belirginleşmesine veya kanıt niteliğine bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; konuşma yetkinliği, anlatım eksikliği ve genel görünürlük sınırları yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البيان بوصفه كشفا عن المعنى، والكلام أو الكتابة أو الإشارة التي تبين المقصود، والفصاحة واللسن.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أبين من فلان أي أوضح كلاما منه (maqayis)؛ البين من الرجال الفصيح (ayn)؛ البيان الفصاحة واللسن (sihah)؛ البيان الكشف عن الشيء وهو أعم من النطق (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البعد بين طرفين، والبئر البعيدة القعر أو الواسعة التي يبعد ما بين شفيرها وقعرها.
يدخل فيه البين من الأرض: القطعة أو الناحية أو الغلظ من الأرض بقدر مد البصر.

branches.branch_image_ar: انفراج العضو أو الشيء عن ملاصقه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بانت يد الناقة عن جنبها، والقوس البائنة التي بان وترها عن كبدها، وإبانة الرأس من الجسد.
يدخل فيه البائن في الحلب: أحد الحالبين أو الذي يأتي الحلوبة من قبل شمالها مقابل المستعلي أو المعلى.

branches.branch_image_ar: الوقت الواقع أثناء حال أو فعل
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بينا وبينما إذا جعلتا بمنزلة حين وأضافتا الجملة إلى زمن الفعل.
يدخل فيه بين بين: ما كان بين الجيد والرديء، أو الهمزة المخففة بين الهمزة وحرف اللين، أو الضعيف غير المعتد به في الشاهد.
يدخل فيه تطليقة بائنة، أي طلاق فاعلة فيه بمعنى مفعولة يدل على انقطاع الرجعة.
يدخل فيه غراب البين بوصفه الغراب الذي يتشاءم به للفراق في الخبر اللغوي.
